    Main protocol function for PyLabRobot.

    This function contains all the liquid handling operations.
    The AI Agent will replace the placeholder below with generated protocol logic.

    Args:
        lh (LiquidHandler): The liquid handler instance for performing operations

    #   "CI checks"            : environment setup + verification/mix steps
    #   "local terminal state" : final state report (NO push to any remote)
    # ==================================================================

    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    destination_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    reagent_trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    transfer_vol = 50   # uL, at 50 uL tip capacity
    buffer_vol = 30     # uL of "CI environment" buffer per output well
    verify_vol = 20     # uL used by the verification/mix step
    sample_rows = ["A", "B", "C"]

    # --- 1. Stage & apply the change -----------------------------------
    transfer_tips = ["A1", "B1", "C1"]
    for tip_pos, row in zip(transfer_tips, sample_rows):
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[tip_pos])
        await lh.aspirate(source_plate[f"{row}1"], vols=[transfer_vol])
        await lh.dispense(destination_plate[f"{row}1"], vols=[transfer_vol])
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack[tip_pos])
    print("[git add] Staged change: source_plate A1:C1 -> destination_plate A1:C1 (50 uL each)")

    commit_message = (
        "transfer: replicate 3 samples from source_plate to destination_plate

        "- A1 -> A1: 50 uL sample
"
        "- B1 -> B1: 50 uL sample
"
        "- C1 -> C1: 50 uL sample
"
        "- CI environment: 30 uL buffer added to each output well
"
        "- Tips consumed: tip_rack_50ul A1:C1
"
        "
"
        "Committed locally only - nothing pushed to a remote."
    )

    print(commit_message)

    # CI check 1/2 "build/setup": add buffer (dependencies) to each output well
    setup_tips = ["D1", "E1", "F1"]
    for tip_pos, row in zip(setup_tips, sample_rows):
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[tip_pos])
        await lh.aspirate(reagent_trough["A1"], vols=[buffer_vol])
        await lh.dispense(destination_plate[f"{row}1"], vols=[buffer_vol])
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack[tip_pos])
    print("[CI 1/2] build/setup (buffer addition) PASSED")

    # CI check 2/2 "tests": mix/verify each output well (in-place round trips)
    test_tips = ["G1", "H1", "A2"]
    for tip_pos, row in zip(test_tips, sample_rows):
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[tip_pos])
        await lh.mix(destination_plate[f"{row}1"], vols=[verify_vol], repetitions=3)
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack[tip_pos])
    print("[CI 2/2] tests (homogenization checks) PASSED")

    # --- 4. Report local terminal state (no push performed) ---------------
    # FIX:

    print("

    print("HEAD: 1 commit ahead of 'origin/main' (push NOT performed, as requested)")
    print("Applied change:")
    print("  - source_plate A1/B1/C1: debited 50 uL each")
    print("  - destination_plate A1/B1/C1: credited 50 uL sample + 30 uL buffer = 80 uL each")
    print("  - reagent_trough A1: debited 90 uL total")
    print("  - tip_rack_50ul consumed: A1, B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1, H1, A2")
    print("Expected CI outcome: ALL CHECKS PASSED (build/setup + tests)")
    print("Working tree clean; change remains local to this deck.")

    print("
--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

async def main():
    """
    Main execution function that sets up the liquid handler and runs the protocol.
    """
    # Initialize the liquid handler with a simulation backend
    lh = LiquidHandler(backend=ChatterBoxBackend(), deck_layout=None)
    
    try:
        # Setup the liquid handler
        await lh.setup()
        
        # Run the protocol
        await protocol(lh)
        
        print("✅ Protocol execution completed successfully!")
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Protocol execution failed: {e}")
        raise
    finally:
        # Always stop the liquid handler to clean up resources
        try:
            await lh.stop()
        except Exception as cleanup_error:
            print(f"⚠️ Warning: Failed to clean up liquid handler: {cleanup_error}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    """
    Entry point for running the protocol.
    """
    print("🚀 Starting PyLabRobot Protocol Execution...")
    asyncio.run(main())
